title.narrative: Promoting Ethics and Bioethics in Science and Technology in Uzbekistan

description.narrative:
In 2025, the UNESCO Office in Uzbekistan plans to revitalize the National Bioethics Committee with the following objectives: 1. To assess and analyze the current state of bioethics in Uzbekistan. 2. To share, present, and promote recent UNESCO publications related to Bioethics. 3. To encourage discussions among scientists, policymakers, and the public to address bioethical dilemmas.
Furthermore, UNESCO Office in Uzbekistan in cooperation with the Ministry of Digital Technology of Uzbekistan plans to implement the Readiness Assessment Methodology. This initiative aims to promote the values and principles outlined in the UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI and to produce a comprehensive country report that aligns Uzbekistan's national AI strategy with UNESCO's guidelines. This will reinforce the OP5 as a matrix workplan.
